parsed_json.sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id AS indication_curie, di.efo_term AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE di.max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%infection%' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind
